To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
methotrexate specifically inhibits tumour necrosis‐factor (TNF)‐α production by splenic cells in mice and prevents collagen‐induced murine arthritis.

MTX specifically modulated TNF production by murine T cells and macro phages in vitro and prevented murine collagen‐type II‐induced arthritis in vivo, which is associated with a reduction of TNF serum levels.
methotrexate specifically inhibits the production of TNF‐α by T cells and prevents the onset of murine collagen‐type II induced arthritis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of action of the anti‐inflammatory drug methotrexate.
the mechanisms of action of immunosuppressants in rheumatoid arthritis and the role of TNF‐α as a target of MTX.
the development of a murine model for rheumatoid arthritis (RA), the so called collagen-induced arthritis (CIA).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MTX is a powerful anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive drug, and that its effects on cytokine and chemokine production may be important for its therapeutic effects in patients with RA.
MTX has a profound impact on TNF production by immune cells in mice.
MTX specifically modulated TNF‐α and IFN‐γ but not IL‐4 production.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MTX specifically modulated spontaneous and IL‐ 15‐induced production of TNF‐α by T‐cells in healthy mice and prevented CIA.
methotrexate is a powerful drug for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, but the mechanisms of methotrexate are poorly understood.
MTX specifically modulate TNF production by murine T cells and macrophaes and thereby prevents the development of experimental murine CIA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MTX specifically modulated cytokine production by spleen T cells and macro phages in healthy mice and in mice with experimental arthritis.
MTX has a direct effect on the production of TNF‐α by T cells, and that this effect can prevent the onset of CIA in mice.
methotrexate specifically inhibits TNF production by murine T cells in vitro and in vivo.
